title: A bug's repro runs the behaviour it names, or says why it cannot
goal: backlog.py new bug accepts a repro that only matches text in a file (grep, a regex over source) only with a stated reason in the item, and kb/_self/backlog.md says a repro runs the behaviour when it can. Failure it answers: SP-76inhw33's BG-qtphqxt2 repro rejected the literal '>&2', which the fix met by writing '>& 2', and BG-g6qpxe5x's repro was a regex over the test's text; neither proved the behaviour, the tests did.
